scanNote:
GRAMMAR 12-BET. Unit 3 nazariyasi — ko'plik, this/these, there is/are, some/any, o'rin predloglari (mashqsiz bet).

Skaner bilan solishtirildi. Beshta blok va oltita predlog rasmi to'g'ri ko'chirilgan.

⚠ KO'PLIK TALAFFUZI — UCh XIL (kitob buni beradi, ko'p darslik bermaydi):
  /s/  — /f/, /k/, /θ/, /p/, /t/ dan keyin: bookS, clockS, catS
  /ɪz/ — /s/, /ks/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/, /z/, /ʒ/ dan keyin: torchES, bridgES, busES
  /z/  — qolgan barcha tovushlardan keyin: tableS, sofaS, mirrorS
  ⚠ Bu — Grammar 17-betdagi fe'l '-s' talaffuzi bilan BIR XIL qoida.

⚠ THIS/THESE va THAT/THOSE — MASOFA:
  YAQIN: this (birlik), these (ko'plik)
  UZOQ:  that (birlik), those (ko'plik)
  ⚠ Rasmlarda barmoq ishorasi masofani ko'rsatadi: soatlar yaqin (this/these), quyonlar uzoq (that/those).
  ⚠ O'zbek tilida ham 'bu'/'shu' va 'u'/'o'sha' farqi bor, lekin ko'plik shakli o'zgarmaydi — inglizchada esa o'zgaradi.

⚠ THERE IS / THERE ARE — keyingi otga qarab tanlanadi, 'there' ning o'ziga emas.
  ⚠ Qisqa javobda ham 'there' saqlanadi: 'Yes, THERE is' ('Yes, it is' emas).

⚠ SOME / ANY / A / AN — UCh QOIDA:
  SOME — tasdiq gapda ko'plik
  ANY  — inkor va savol gapda ko'plik
  A/AN — birlik (tasdiq, inkor, savolda ham)
  ⚠ 'There isn't AN elephant' — inkorda ham birlik uchun 'an' ishlatiladi.

⚠ OLTI PREDLOG RASMI: on (devor ustidagi mushuk), in front of (o'rindiq oldidagi erkak), under (stol ostidagi it), behind (stol orqasidagi sehrgar), next to (kompyuter yonidagi erkak), in (kulba ichidagi it).

rule.explanationUz:
Grammar Book bu qoidani Coursebook 20-betdagidan BATAFSILROQ beradi:
bu yerda ko'plik qo'shimchasining TALAFFUZI ham bor.

DIQQAT — ikki kitob orasidagi kichik farq:
  Coursebook: -ss, -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o → -es
  Grammar:    -ss, -s, -sh, -ch, -x     → -es
Grammar Book '-o' ni sanamagan, lekin u ham -es oladi:
  tomato → tomatoes, potato → potatoes

rules.enRule: Most nouns take -s in the plural.
examples: a table - two tables

rules.enRule: Nouns ending in -ss, -s, -sh, -ch, -x take -es in the plural.
examples: a dress - two dresses
a bus - two buses
a brush - two brushes
a torch - two torches
a box - two boxes

rule.pluralNoteUz:
TALAFFUZ (kitobdagi Pronunciation qismi):
Ko'plik qo'shimchasi UCH XIL o'qiladi — bu yozuvda ko'rinmaydi,
lekin gapirishda muhim.

  /s/  — ot /f/, /k/, /θ/, /p/ yoki /t/ tovushi bilan tugasa
         books, clocks, cats

  /ɪz/ — ot /s/, /ks/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/, /z/ yoki /ʒ/ tovushi bilan tugasa
         torches, bridges, buses
         (bu holda qo'shimcha ALOHIDA bo'g'in bo'ladi!)

  /z/  — boshqa har qanday tovushdan keyin
         tables, sofas, mirrors
rule.extraUz:
NEGA shunday? Til o'zi qulaylikka moslashadi:
  • jarangsiz tovushdan keyin jarangsiz /s/ oson
  • jarangli tovushdan keyin jarangli /z/ oson
  • 's' tovushidan keyin yana 's' aytib bo'lmaydi — orasiga /ɪ/ qo'shiladi

O'zbek tilida ham shunga o'xshash hodisa bor: 'kitob' + 'lar',
lekin 'gap' + 'lar' — talaffuzda tovushlar bir-biriga moslashadi.

exercises.instructionEn: How is the plural suffix pronounced?
exercises.explanationUz:
Uchta variant: /s/, /z/ yoki /ɪz/.

OSON YO'L:
  1) so'zning OXIRGI TOVUSHINI ayting (harfni emas!)
  2) u s, sh, ch, ge, z bo'lsa → /ɪz/ (qo'shimcha alohida bo'g'in)
  3) u p, t, k, f bo'lsa → /s/
  4) qolgan hammasi → /z/

rule.explanationUz:
Grammar Book rasmlar bilan tushuntiradi:
  bitta soat  → This is a clock.
  ikkita soat → These are clocks.
  bitta quyon (uzoqda)  → That is a rabbit.
  ikkita quyon (uzoqda) → Those are rabbits.

              BITTA    KO'P
  YAQIN       this     these
  UZOQ        that     those

rules.uzRule: YAQINdagi odam, hayvon yoki narsani ko'rsatish uchun this/these.
rules.enRule: We use this/these to point to people, animals or things near us.
examples: This is a clock.
These are clocks.

rules.uzRule: UZOQdagi odam, hayvon yoki narsani ko'rsatish uchun that/those.
rules.enRule: We use that/those to point to people, animals or things far from us.
examples: That is a rabbit.
Those are rabbits.

rule.warningUz:
Fe'l ham o'zgaradi — buni unutmang:
  this / that   → IS   (birlik)
  these / those → ARE  (ko'plik)

  ❌ These is clocks.   ✅ These ARE clocks.
  ❌ Those is rabbits.  ✅ Those ARE rabbits.

Va ot ham ko'plikka o'tadi: clock → clockS, rabbit → rabbitS.
rule.noteUz:
Kitob 'people, animals or things' deydi — ya'ni bu olmoshlar
ODAMLAR uchun ham ishlatiladi:
  This is my brother.   — Bu mening akam.
  These are my friends. — Bular mening do'stlarim.

Tanishtirishda ham shu ishlatiladi: 'This is Ann.'

exercises.instructionEn: Choose this, these, that or those.
exercises.instructionUz: this, these, that yoki those — birini tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Ikki savolga javob bering: YAQINMI-UZOQMI va BITTAMI-KO'PMI.

rule.titleUz: 'There is / There are' va qisqa javoblar
rule.explanationUz:
Biror joyda nimadir borligini aytish uchun.
  There IS  — bitta narsa
  There ARE — ko'p narsa

keyRules.enRule: We use there is in the singular.
examples: There is a desk in my room.

keyRules.enRule: We use there are in the plural.
examples: There are five books on my desk.

examples.q: Is there a sofa in the living-room?
Are there any chairs in the room?

rule.noteUz:
QISQA JAVOB — kitobdagi 'Short answers' jadvali.

Qisqa javobda ot TAKRORLANMAYDI:
  ❌ Yes, there is a sofa.
  ✅ Yes, there is.

Va 'there' so'zi ham TUSHIB QOLMAYDI:
  ❌ Yes, it is.
  ✅ Yes, there is.

Savolda 'Is/Are' oldinga chiqadi:
  There is a sofa. → IS THERE a sofa?
  There are chairs. → ARE THERE any chairs?

exercises.instructionEn: Complete with there is, there are, Is there or Are there.
exercises.instructionUz: there is, there are, Is there yoki Are there — birini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: Otga qarang: bittami (a desk) yoki ko'pmi (five books)?

items.textEn: ____ a sofa in the living-room? — Yes, there is.
____ any chairs in the room? — Yes, there are.
Is there a sofa in the living-room? — No, ____ .
items.whyUz: Birlik inkor qisqa javob. 'it isn't' EMAS.

items.textEn: Are there any chairs in the room? — No, ____ .

rule.titleUz: some, any, a/an — qachon qaysi biri
rule.explanationUz:
Uchta so'z, uchta vazifa. Ikki savolga qarab tanlanadi:
  1) ot BIRLIKMI yoki KO'PLIKMI?
  2) gap TASDIQMI, INKORMI yoki SAVOLMI?

  BIRLIK  → a / an  (har uchala gapda ham)
  KO'PLIK + tasdiq → some
  KO'PLIK + inkor yoki savol → any

keyRules.uzRule: TASDIQ gapda ko'plik ot bilan — some.
keyRules.enRule: We use some in the affirmative with plural nouns.
examples: There are some chairs in the room.

keyRules.uzRule: INKOR yoki SAVOL gapda ko'plik ot bilan — any.
keyRules.enRule: We use any in the negative or interrogative with plural nouns.
examples: There aren't any pictures on the wall.
Are there any chairs in the room?

keyRules.uzRule: BIRLIK ot bilan — a/an (gap turidan qat'i nazar).
keyRules.enRule: We use a/an with singular nouns.
examples: There is a book on my desk.
There isn't an elephant in the zoo.
Is there a vase on the table?

rule.warningUz:
A yoki AN?
  a  — undosh TOVUSH bilan boshlansa: a book, a desk, a vase
  an — unli TOVUSH bilan boshlansa: an elephant, an armchair, an attic

HARF emas, TOVUSH muhim:
  an hour   (h o'qilmaydi, 'auer' deb boshlanadi)
  a university ('yuniversiti' — 'y' tovushi, undosh)
rule.extraUz:
Kitobdagi misolda diqqat qiling:
  'There ISN'T AN elephant in the zoo.'
Inkor gap, lekin ot BIRLIK — shuning uchun 'any' emas, 'an'.
Ya'ni 'any' faqat KO'PLIK bilan ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose some, any, a or an.
exercises.instructionUz: some, any, a yoki an — birini tanlang.

items.textEn: There are ____ chairs in the room.
There aren't ____ pictures on the wall.
Are there ____ chairs in the room?
There is ____ book on my desk.
items.whyUz: 'book' birlik va undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi → a.

items.textEn: There isn't ____ elephant in the zoo.
items.whyUz: 'elephant' birlik va UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi → an. Inkor bo'lsa ham 'any' emas, chunki ot birlik.

items.textEn: Is there ____ vase on the table?
items.whyUz: 'vase' birlik va undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi → a. Savol bo'lsa ham 'any' emas.

rule.titleUz: on, in front of, under, behind, next to, in
rule.explanationUz:
Grammar Book oltita predlogni rasm bilan ko'rsatadi.
Har bir rasmni eslab qolsangiz, predlogni hech qachon adashtirmaysiz.

examples: The cat is on the fence.
There is a carpet on the floor.
The man is in front of the bench.
There is a table in front of the sofa.
The dog is under the table.
There is a ball under the table.
The magician is behind the table.
There is a garage behind the building.
The man is next to the computer.
There is a lamp next to the bed.
The dog is in the kennel.
There are some flowers in the vase.

rule.noteUz:
Kitobdagi rasmlar:
  on          — mushuk devor USTIDA uxlayapti
  in front of — erkak skameyka OLDIDA turibdi
  under       — kuchuk stol OSTIDA o'tiribdi
  behind      — sehrgar stol ORQASIDA turibdi
  next to     — erkak kompyuter YONIDA o'tiribdi
  in          — it uy ICHIDA (kataksida)
rule.warningUz:
IN FRONT OF — uch so'z, hammasi kerak:
  ✅ in front of the bench
  ❌ in front the bench

NEXT TO — 'to' shart:
  ✅ next to the computer
  ❌ next the computer

IN va ON:
  in the box   — quti ICHIDA
  on the box   — quti USTIDA

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar Book 12-bet — ko'plik va artikl shakllari.

groups.explanationUz: Yozuvda bir xil (-s / -es), lekin og'zaki nutqda uch xil o'qiladi.
Artikl keyingi so'zning birinchi TOVUSHIGA qarab tanlanadi, harfiga emas.
Bir xil ma'no ('bir nechta'), lekin gap turiga qarab almashadi.

patterns.formula: This/That is a + birlik ot. — These/Those are + ko'plik ot.
patterns.exampleEn: This is a clock. These are clocks. That is a rabbit. Those are rabbits.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu soat. Bular soatlar. U quyon. Ular quyonlar.
patterns.explanationUz:
Olmosh, fe'l va ot — uchalasi ham birga o'zgaradi.
Bittasini o'zgartirib, boshqasini unutish — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

patterns.formula: There is a + birlik ot + joy. / There are + son/some + ko'plik ot + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: There is a desk in my room. There are five books on my desk.
patterns.exampleUz: Xonamda yozuv stoli bor. Yozuv stolimda beshta kitob bor.
patterns.explanationUz: Aniq son bo'lsa 'some' kerak emas: 'There are FIVE books' (some emas).

patterns.formula: Is there a ...? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Is there a sofa in the living-room? — Yes, there is.

patterns.formula: Are there any ...? — Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
patterns.exampleEn: Are there any chairs in the room? — No, there aren't.
There isn't an elephant in the zoo.
patterns.explanationUz: Inkor gap, lekin ot birlik — shuning uchun 'any' emas, 'an'.

patterns.exampleEn: The cat is on the fence. The dog is in the kennel.
patterns.explanationUz: Predlogdan keyin odatda 'the' keladi — chunki qaysi joy ekani ma'lum.
